I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`. The test makes four calls, so it stays at roughly 4 requests per second, under the 5/s limit. I haven't run the test, so I haven't confirmed the CI flake is gone.

The interval is a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant at the top of the file, so it's easy to tune. I also saved a note about the sandbox's 5 req/s limit to project memory.
